notes.title: GAME UPDATE: 0.5.158 - WEDNESDAY, MAY, 23
notes.content:
Commanders!

On Wednesday, May 23, from 12:00 am - 4:00 am PST, we will be releasing our new update.  Be sure to ground all aircraft, dock all ships, and garrison all ground units.  The details are below:

- Fixed the chat refresh issue.  Now players will see the chat instantly!
- Decreased the amount of times the snow weather appears. More clear skies ahead!
- Remove the snow’s debuff effect on movement. Nothing slows down a determined army!
- Shorten the production time of Sherman from 12 sec. to 10 sec.  Get those tanks rolling out faster!
- Shorten the production time of Recon Jeep from 4 sec. to 3 sec.
- Fixed some language issues and rewrote some descriptions for more clarity and details.
- Increased the requirement of unlocking the second portrait from 50 to 150.
- Increased the leadership point of Battle Level 40 from 80 to 81.
- Increase the basic HP of turrets. Your defenses are stronger than ever!

notes.title: GAME UPDATE: 0.5.159 - Friday, April 27
notes.content:
Update: Version 0.5.159

Commanders!  We will have an update this Friday, April 27 @ 12:00 - 1:00 am.  The update will include:

- Updated armament and buildings descriptions!  Easier to read with more details!

- Building reconstruction time is now faster!

- We fixed the display problem after changing the city flag.

- We adjusted the chat censorship.

- A weather system!  Players can now play in various weather conditions including night and snow!

- A new, more exciting story for the map!

https://youtu.be/yNUqwWbsk94

notes.title: Update 0.5.121 is Live! Increased building and unit queue!
notes.content:
Updates include:

- Players can now use the following national flags for their capitals:  Hong Kong, New Zealand, Vietnam, Serbia, Kazakhstan, United Arab Emirates, Kenya, Myanmar, Nepal, Montenegro, Puerto Rico, Algeria, Republic of Malta, Nigeria and the Dominican Republic!

- We adjusted the respawn features to create more fair and balanced maps!

- Players now have two 4-hour protection shields!

- Chat: Fixed the censorship and word cut off.

- Increased building and unit queue!  Build more buildings and troops at once!

- Better and more realistic sound effects!

- Adjusted the sniper tower colors so that they accurately represent their alliance.
